title: Ravik Rail Link adds two freight paths for the summer

facts.subject: Ravik Rail Link
facts.statement: The Ravik Rail Link will run additional freight paths each weekday from June to August.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Ravik Rail Link will run additional freight paths each weekday from June to August.

facts.subject: Ravik Rail Link
facts.statement: Paths leave early in the morning and in the late afternoon. All take grain wagons and general freight.

source_ref.text_snippet: Paths leave early in the morning and in the late afternoon. All take grain wagons and general freight.

flagged_facts.subject: Ravik Rail Link
flagged_facts.statement: The extra paths are aimed at seasonal demand from grain and general freight customers, and the link says they will be reviewed at the end of the summer.
